*Written for version 0.1.14. Source: [Quarto guidance](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/r-analysis-workflow/blob/main/plugin/references/quarto.md), [the starter site](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/r-analysis-workflow/blob/main/plugin/assets/starter/_quarto.yml), [the document-analysis skill](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/r-analysis-workflow/blob/main/plugin/skills/document-analysis/SKILL.md), [the AGENTS.md template](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/r-analysis-workflow/blob/main/plugin/assets/AGENTS.md), [GitHub workflow](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/r-analysis-workflow/blob/main/plugin/references/github-workflow.md).*

Every project publishes a website, built with Quarto (a tool that turns text and code files into web pages), that explains the analysis code to a clinician reader. The website shows the code and explains it; **it never runs the analysis**, so it is built without the analysis data. These pages go through the files that make up the site, in the order you meet them in a repository. The plugin gives a new project a starter copy of each one.
